results.title: Ganpati Bappa Morya Echoes Across Madhya Pradesh As Devotees Bid Grand Farewell To Lord Ganesha
results.description: Ganeshotsav celebrations filled Meghnagar, Susner, Mandleshwar, Kasrawad and Jaora with devotional fervour as devotees joined immersion processions, maha-aartis and cultural programmes. Bands, DJs, fireworks and chants of ‘Ganpati Bappa Morya’ marked the festivities, while elaborate themed pandals and traditional rituals drew large gatherings.

results.title: Supreme Court Tightens, Clarifies Rules On Commercial Use Of Residential Areas; Issues 3-Point Directions
results.description: The Supreme Court has clarified enforcement against commercial activities in residential areas, laying down three key principles covering residential-only zones, unclear land use and pending disputes. The court also scrutinised allegations of inadequate compliance in Bhopal, while the existing Master Plan and building rules remain relevant pending finalisation of a new plan.
